limits: Offline tests do not establish live provider availability or relevance precision.

The free metadata request cap applies per invocation and across successfully persisted collection states. If later publication fails, journal-state remains untouched; repeated whole-update failures can repeat free requests. This is not a hard global daily reservation or financial-cost budget.
Real private corpus replay, network recovery and browser queue verification are main-agent/other-agent evidence, not claimed by this receipt.
